caseNameFull: R. D. Langan v. City of Louisville
summary: Error to the Court of Appeals of the State of Kentucky.
attorneys: .Mr. John Bryce Baskin, with whom Mr. Alex. Pope Humphrey was on the brief, for plaintiffs in error., Mr. Harry E. Tincher, with whom Mr. Jos. S.- Lawton and Mr. M. H. Thatcher were on the briefs,, for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want'of jurisdiction upon the authority of Manhattan Life Insurance Co. v. Cohen, 234 U. S. 123, 136; Consolidated Turnpike v. Norfolk, &c. Ry. Co., 228 U. S. 596, 600.
